reasoning_trace.value: The paper includes several figures, including Fig. 1, which shows the schematic of the proposed carrier laser PN retrieval method in a West-End to East-End coherent transmission link. Fig. 4 is a schematic and picture of the piezo electric driven vibro-acoustic transducer. Fig. 5 plots the peak-to-peak phase variation induced by the transducer device driven by sinusoid signals at different frequencies and peak-to-peak voltage. Fig. 6 shows the frequency noise power spectral density of the vibration-induced phase change. Fig. 7 shows the extracted temporal vibration phase waveform and localization results. Fig. 8 presents the standard deviation and localization error versus vibration center frequency and bandwidth. Fig. 9 shows the vibration localization results and 16 QAM signal SNR. Fig. 10 shows the recovered 60-Gbaud 16-QAM constellations. Fig. 11 shows the vibration localization performance with and without the denoising method. Fig. 12 shows the vibration spectra for an emulated tampering event.

reasoning_trace.value: The system uses a carrier laser phase noise retrieval method to enhance vibration detection and localization in optical networks. The method introduces a relative delay between two frequency tones generated at the transmitter and retrieves an estimate of the transmitter laser phase noise at the coherent receiver. This allows for the mitigation of laser phase noise and improvement of vibration detection and localization precision.
